source_review.algorithm: Production setup/loop and comms objects reused; adapter includes normal numerical setup helpers with renamed main, overrides only serial fake queue/time seams. Static ADC passes production sensors/calibration; no ECU-protocol facade.
source_review.threading: Mock setup and epoch/base initialization happen before worker creation; production globals are worker-only. RX/TX deque operations use io_mutex; line output uses separate output_mutex without observed lock cycle.
source_review.timing: Wall clock services busy-read deadlines; virtual timers catch up between loop calls. Safe interpretation is stopped-engine serial characterization, not plant/timing equivalence.
source_review.persistence: Production M changes RAM immediately; b may defer native EEPROM writes. New fixture process configures independent fake EEPROM; no restart/physical persistence claim.
source_review.reference_limit: 16KiB adapter queue bounds do not validate pinned upstream serialPayloadLength against517-byte native payload buffer. Fixture is owned-app valid-traffic positive control; upstream malformed-frame parser behavior is not qualified.

findings.finding: Current builder checks reused object existence and records hashes after link, without binding those bytes to attested base binary. Separate serial lock leaves base-cache rebuild race.

findings.recommendation: Hold base build.lock, relink original complete object set into serial cache, compare exact attested base binary hash, bind input hashes before/after use.
